raw:
{
  "process": "Each row is a passenger on the Titanic. The sequence of events is: passenger boards the ship (with ticket, class, fare, family info, age, sex, embarkation port), the ship sails, the ship hits an iceberg and sinks, passengers either survive (in a lifeboat) or die (body recovered or missing), and records are compiled afterward.",
  "target_known_at": "The moment the sinking is over and survival status is determined (i.e., whether the passenger is rescued or dies).",
  "prediction_point": "The moment just before the ship departs (or at boarding), when a prediction of survival would be made for a passenger.",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "fare", "event": "Ticket price paid at booking/boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "boat", "event": "Lifeboat assignment during the sinking", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "parch", "event": "Family composition known at boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "body", "event": "Body recovery after the sinking", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "pclass", "event": "Passenger class assigned at booking/boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "age", "event": "Age known at boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "sibsp", "event": "Family composition known at boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "sex", "event": "Sex known at boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "embarked", "event": "Port of embarkation known at boarding", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0}
  ]
}
